svg.title: AWS Exposed Module Architecture
svg.desc: Framework adapters resolve AWS configuration and pass final JDBC settings to the shared Exposed foundation, which creates Hikari-backed Exposed database handles.
svg.text: Shared JDBC foundation: AWS-aware adapters supply resolved settings; this module creates Exposed database handles.
Secrets Manager, Parameter Store, profiles, and runtime config are resolved before entering this foundation.
Source-backed contracts validate database names, auth mode, driver class, and cleanup behavior.
Runtime output: Exposed Database handles connect to caller-selected JDBC drivers, RDS endpoints, H2 tests, or PostgreSQL Testcontainers.
